reviews_captured_by_me.text: Mike, Heather, and their crew are wonderful!!! They are very professional and great to work with!
Heather and Mike are such super folks to work with while doing a remodel. Their entire crew are super talented and kind and willing to make you happy.

Using this business was a train wreck. First it took them 3 trys to get our vanity tops right. Then they cut our counter tops wrong and messed up our beautiful slabs of quartzite so then we had to settle for different slabs. And those were cut wrong!!! They were able to trim those on site and make them work. The headache of using this business is not worth it.
